label: Compare Azure List Prices
mcp_tool_description: Looks up Azure public list prices (Azure Retail Prices API, USD, pay-as-you-go unless price_type says otherwise) for any Azure service, restricted to the regions of the Azure environments the calling user can order into, and estimates monthly cost where the meter's unit allows it. Read-only: never provisions, orders, or changes anything. Give at least one filter. service_name and arm_sku_name are exact and case-sensitive; service_contains, product_contains, sku_contains and meter_contains are substring matches. Spot and Low Priority meters are dropped unless include_spot is true. Hourly meters are scaled by hours_per_month (default 730); per-month meters are used as-is; per-unit meters (GB/Month, 10K operations, and so on) need quantity_per_month, otherwise estMonthlyUsd is null and the unit is reported so you can multiply. Reservation rows are term prices converted to monthly. If the result is truncated or empty, use the returned hints (distinct service, product, SKU and meter names) to refine the filters and call again. Examples: a Linux VM is service_name 'Virtual Machines' with arm_sku_name 'Standard_D4s_v5' (Linux rows have no 'Windows' in productName; add product_contains 'Windows' for Windows); a Premium SSD disk is service_name 'Storage' with product_contains 'Premium SSD Managed Disks' and sku_contains 'P30 LRS'; a PostgreSQL flexible server is service_contains 'PostgreSQL' with product_contains 'Flexible Server' and sku_contains '4 vCore'. Prices exclude discounts, credits and tax and are not a quote. Do not use for on-prem or non-Azure environments.
